proposed_additions.definition: A fact about the initiation or progression of a legal case or proceeding
examples: The High Court adopted a multiple of 27 for capitalisation.
The sum prescribed for the purposes of all second appeals to the High Court is Rs 50,000
The police initiated proceedings under Section 151, 107 and 116 Cr.P.C. on 19.07.2016.
An application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. was filed by Sajjad Quraishi on 29.08.2016.

proposed_additions.definition: A fact stating a measurable quantity related to a case, such as capacity, production, consumption, or demand.
examples: The total capacity of all the 9 distilleries was 203 lacs proof litres.
The total capacity of all 9 distilleries was 203 lacs proof litres.
The total production of country liquor in 1981-82 was 129 lacs proof litres.
The estimated consumption of country liquor was expected to be 482.36 lacs proof litres by 1991.
